title: llm.embed
description: Text embeddings through the configured backend (explicit provider > DEFAULT_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER). Returns {status: 'ok', embeddings: NormalizedEmbeddings, provider_used: string} or {status: 'failure', reason: string}. Vectors preserve input order; the ledger records counts/usage only — never the texts, never the vectors. Every reply that wrote ledger rows also carries metering: {provider, model, cost_usd, cost_basis, priced_by, input_tokens, output_tokens, thinking_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_write_tokens, audio_duration_ms, duration_ms, fallback_used, calls} — sums over every provider call this request made (fallback chain, map-reduce, retries); provider/model name the call that produced the result; a checkpoint or cache hit reports cost_usd 0 with cost_basis 'cached'. An optional context {recording_id, stage, run_id, attempt} is stored on each PromptLog row as metadata.context.

texts.description: Batch of texts to embed. Output vectors preserve this order. Empty batches and empty strings are rejected.

model.description: Concrete embedding model name (NOT a size alias like llm.complete's) overriding the registration pin / the provider's configured default. The caller owns its embedding SPACE: vectors from different models are not comparable, so an indexer that stamps rows with a model and filters searches by it must be able to ask for that exact model. Providers that cannot select one (single-model self-hosted servers) ignore it and report what actually ran in embeddings.model — the response is the attribution, never the request.

timeout_seconds.description: Hard cap on the embeddings request.

provider_options.description: Free-form per-provider passthrough, applied AFTER the adapter's own request params — pin provider specifics without a core release. Unknown keys go to the provider as-is.

user_id.description: Who this call is for — recorded on the PromptLog row so per-user cost is answerable. Opaque to this package: any id shape the host uses. Optional; omitting it leaves the row unattributed, never rejected.

workspace_id.description: Which tenant this call is for — recorded on the PromptLog row so per-workspace cost is answerable without summing over its members. Optional, opaque, recorded only.

context.description: Who this call is FOR inside the caller's own pipeline (a recording, the stage, the run and the attempt). Stored on every PromptLog row the call writes, under metadata.context; recorded only, never acted on.
